gibbs-signs.alt: A two by two grid of the signs of ΔH° and ΔS°. ΔH° negative with ΔS° positive: favored at all temperatures. ΔH° negative with ΔS° negative: favored at low temperature, below ΔH°/ΔS°. ΔH° positive with ΔS° positive: favored at high temperature, above ΔH°/ΔS°. ΔH° positive with ΔS° negative: not favored at any temperature.
